PockPock Agent 0.2.10 makes OpenClaw work in the folder you choose. It adds a **Full auto** mode and an optional **uncensored model** for OpenClaw. It protects against instructions hidden in web pages, and it makes plans and agent runs more reliable with small local models. The Maintenance Manager now asks before it uses an account that is already signed in on your PC.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

**Already using 0.2.9 on Windows?** PockPock updates itself: press **Restart to update** when it appears, or check in **Settings → Updates**. Your chats, settings, models and caches are kept. On a Mac, download and install it once, the same way as the first time.

**New to PockPock?** Open the downloaded file, then press **Set up PockPock**; setup installs everything else. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki/Installation).

## What's new since 0.2.9

### OpenClaw works in your folder

- OpenClaw used to ignore the folder you opened and always worked in its own folder (`.openclaw\workspace`). Now its commands run in the folder you chose, and files given without a full path are read and saved there.
- The permission menu now has a **Task folder** section for OpenClaw too: **Work in *folder*** or **Use OpenClaw's workspace**. The Inspector shows which one is in use.
- Changing the folder in the middle of a task applies from the next message, and the conversation is kept.

### Full auto and an uncensored model for OpenClaw

- **Full auto** is a new choice in OpenClaw's permission menu, marked Risky. Nothing asks, as in Full access, and the agent keeps going on its own: it does not stop to ask questions, it can work for up to 4 hours instead of 30 minutes, and it is only stopped after 30 quiet minutes.
- OpenClaw's model menu can download **Qwen 3.5 9B uncensored** (6.6 GB, `huihui_ai/qwen3.5-abliterated:9b`). It is a community build with its refusals removed, so it does what you ask, including things the normal model declines. You are responsible for how you use it. Nothing is downloaded until you press the button.
- Ask first, Auto-approve safe and Full access work as before.

### Protection against instructions hidden in web pages

- A web page, a search result or an MCP server can contain text that tries to give the agent instructions.
- In **Ask first** and **Auto-approve safe**, once an OpenClaw task has read such content, **Allow for this task** no longer approves later actions automatically. Each later approval card warns about it and offers only **Allow once** or **Deny**.

### More reliable plans and runs

- Plans from local models now follow a fixed format while they are written, so a small model can no longer return a plan PockPock cannot read. If a reply is still unusable, PockPock asks once more.
- If the agent calls the same tool with the same input a third time without anything changing, the call is not repeated, and the agent is told to use the result it already has. A run that keeps repeating is stopped with a clear message instead of using up its turns.

### Maintenance Manager asks before using your account

- If Claude Code, OpenAI Codex or Copilot was already signed in on your PC (for example from your editor), **Connect this account** connected it with one click and no sign-in page. Now it first asks: "Use the *company* account signed in on this PC (*your email, plan*)?", with **Use this account** and **Cancel**.

### Reports without a description

- In **Report a problem**, the description is now optional: choose what went wrong and press **Save**. The conversation that is saved with the report already shows what happened; a description still helps.

### Installing by hand starts clean

- Installing PockPock from a downloaded installer or DMG now removes the old app's caches (browser caches and old update downloads). Updating from inside the app keeps them. Your chats, settings, keys and models are always kept.

## Good to know

- Every pull request in this release passed the full check suite (backend tests and desktop typecheck and build on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS).
- Tested live: plans with `qwen3.5:9b` in the new format (3 of 3 on the first try, 8–14 s each), and OpenClaw working in a chosen folder (on a test gateway with a stand-in model).
- Not tested yet: the uncensored model download and a turn with it, a 4-hour Full auto run, and the installer's cache cleanup on a real reinstall.
- Help and screenshots are in the [wiki](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki). Please [report problems](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/issues/new/choose).
